description: buildDocument: the complete page. Markdown is converted; HTML is framed with the policy and print styles; script elements are removed before framing. Args are [content, title].

cases.name: markdown page
cases.expected:
Title

Body text.

cases.name: title is escaped
cases.expected: x

cases.name: empty title falls back to Document
cases.expected: x

cases.name: null content and title
cases.expected:
<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:;" />
<title>Document</title>
<style>
  @page { size: A4; margin: 18mm 16mm 16mm 16mm; }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }

  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: Aptos, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 11pt;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: #111;
  }

  h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
    font-family: "Aptos Display", Aptos, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    color: #0f4761;
    line-height: 1.25;
    margin: 1.4em 0 0.5em;
    break-after: avoid;
    page-break-after: avoid;
  }

  h1 { font-size: 20pt; margin-top: 0; }
  h2 { font-size: 15pt; }
  h3 { font-size: 12.5pt; }
  h4, h5, h6 { font-size: 11pt; }

  p { margin: 0 0 0.75em; orphans: 2; widows: 2; }

  ul, ol { margin: 0 0 0.9em; padding-left: 1.6em; }
  li { margin: 0.2em 0; }

  a { color: #0b5cad; text-decoration: none; }

  code {
    font-family: "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "Courier New", monospace;
    font-size: 9.5pt;
    background: #f2f2f4;
    padding: 0.1em 0.3em;
    border-radius: 3px;
  }

  pre {
    background: #f6f6f8;
    border: 1px solid #dcdce2;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    break-inside: avoid;
    page-break-inside: avoid;
    margin: 0 0 1em;
  }

  pre code { background: none; padding: 0; font-size: 9pt; }

  blockquote {
    margin: 0 0 0.9em;
    padding: 0.1em 0 0.1em 0.9em;
    border-left: 3px solid #ccccd4;
    color: #444;
  }

  hr { border: none; border-top: 1px solid #d8d8de; margin: 1.4em 0; }

  table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    margin: 0 0 1em;
    font-size: 10pt;
  }

  thead { display: table-header-group; }

  th, td {
    border: 1px solid #d0d0d8;
    padding: 5px 8px;
    text-align: left;
    vertical-align: top;
  }

  th { background: #f2f2f4; font-weight: 600; }

  tr { break-inside: avoid; page-break-inside: avoid; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

</body>
</html>
